title: First clean wip round is recorded as pushed without a push; commits can be lost
body:
When the tree equals HEAD and no ticfac-wip-pushed record exists, pushWipCheckpoint writes the record and exits 3 without pushing, assuming HEAD is on origin. After a restore (which deletes .git's record) or a round-1 commit, HEAD has moved past origin, so the agent's commits are not pushed. A further container loss restores the older tip.
evidence: harness/src/workspace/checkpoints.ts:215-216
